name: prompt-coach
description: Scores your prompt draft as you type and rewrites it before you send it. Choose the model, language and verbosity. Terminal, desktop and VS Code.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that rewrites the draft. haiku is the cheapest and fast; sonnet and opus cost more per rewrite; session uses the session's own model, whatever it is.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. auto follows the draft. The proposal always keeps the language of the draft.

verbosity.title: Verbosity
verbosity.description: Length of the proposal: concise (one line per section, about 100 words), balanced (about 250) or detailed (about 330, with a short plan).

projectRules.title: Project rules
projectRules.description: Read the project's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (up to 4000 characters) so constraints come from the repo's own rules. Adds some tokens to each rewrite.

holdPasted.title: Hold prompts with pasted text
holdPasted.description: Claude Code only lets a mod read pasted text (and Wispr Flow dictation, which arrives pasted) when you press Enter. When on, a weak prompt with pasted text is held there, in any surface, and the pane shows a proposal made from the full content.
